description.en: Charismatic and generous, everyone is attracted by Leo's magnetic field. As a natural leader this star sign will take care of the well being of his family and beyond and loves the recognition for these efforts. This pendant is available in 18 karat gold and sterling silver. Dimensions: approximately 21 x 15 x 2 mm.
